messages:
Maria: Heads-up — I'm consolidating a bunch of callable-output snippets and retiring duplicates in the docs repo. PR tracking: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 :wave:
Maria: Goal: one minimal python + ts example for function/tool calling, a compact JSON schema example, and a short migration note for older SDKs. Keep examples tiny and copy-paste friendly.
Sam: @Maria I can own the Python SDK snippets. I'll audit for breaking changes with the v2 call API.
Chris: I'll handle TypeScript examples and do a pass for link fixes. I already found ~8 broken links in the legacy folder.
Lee: I'll run parser tests and add guardrail examples for nullable fields and arrays. Also will add a small regression eval.
Maria: Suggested structured-output example to include (feel free to simplify):
```json
{
  "tool": "weather",
  "args": {
    "location": "San Francisco",
    "units": "C"
  }
}
```
Maria: And show a minimal schema snippet we can inline:
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "tool": {"type": "string"},
    "args": {"type": "object"}
  },
  "required": ["tool"]
}
```
Maria: Also add a tiny parsing fallback example and a short note: prefer schema validation, but show `try/except` fallback to naive parsing.
Sam: Python SDK sketch I'll use:
```python
resp = rwd.chat.call_tool("weather", {"location": "SF"})
if resp.is_structured():
    data = resp.parse_json()  # validated against schema
else:
    # naive fallback for older responses
    data = heuristic_parse(resp.text)
```
Sam: I'll open branch `docs/snippet-consolidation/python` today.
Chris: TS mirror will include typing and a short note about runtime validation. I'll update links from `/docs/tool-calling` -> `/docs/callables` as part of the PR.
Lee: Guardrails I'll add: missing required key, unexpected extra keys, nullable arrays. I'll include tiny unit tests for each case.
docs-bot: Automated link scan: 8 broken links detected in `examples/old-tool-calls/` — details: https://ci.redwood-inference/links/4821
Maria: Timeline: open PRs by EOD Thursday, aim to merge next Tuesday after doc + devex review. @Sam @Chris please tag `devex` for quick SDK sanity checks.
Sam: tagging `devex` now. :white_check_mark:
Chris: tagging `devex` and `eng-runtime` for perf/compat sanity.
Lee: I'll add parse-fallback unit tests and run CI, will post results here.
Maria: Also add a short migration blurb for customers on older SDKs and link to the compat shim at `examples/compat/README.md`.
Sam: noted — will include `from rwd.compat import call_tool_legacy` snippet.
Chris: Question: keep the old multi-page examples or redirect? I vote redirecting to the consolidated page and adding an archive anchor for old copies.
Maria: Redirect + archive anchor is the plan. Avoid duplication of canonical snippets.
Sam: Draft PR (python + migration blurb): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4822
Chris: Opening TS draft now -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823
Lee: CI started for parse tests, link-check triggered. Will report back when green.
Maria: Once PRs are up I'll do a final pass for wording and run through the shipping checklist: `compat note`, `guardrail examples`, `parse fallback`, `link fixes`.
Chris: Can someone assign docs reviewers? @Maria
Maria: Assigning to @Sam, @Chris, @Lee, and @Emily (docowner). Emily, please ping if timing conflicts with other priorities.
Emily: Emily: got it, moving to my review queue. I'll make sure the migration phrasing is clear and concise.
Lee: CI passed for parse-fallback tests :white_check_mark:
Sam: added a short note about tokenization edgecases in the python snippet and a quick lint pass.
Maria: Thanks everyone. I'll merge after docowner signoff and thumbs-up from `devex`. :shipit:
Maria: Leaving thread open for any follow-ups — please post commits/links here so this remains the single audit trail.
